title: Multigraded Lefschetz for F2-homology spheres in characteristics zero and two
author: Oba, Ryoshun
work: Multigraded strong Lefschetz property for balanced simplicial complexes
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an anisotropic multigraded pairing using differentiation of the evaluation map in characteristic two, then proves simultaneous Lefschetz isomorphisms and lifts the result to characteristic zero. Sections 4–6 carry these nonroutine algebraic and combinatorial arguments; they are not assumed as background.
